prompt:
A $2.0\ \text{kg}$ block is released from rest at the top of a rough ramp. The top of the ramp is $1.5\ \text{m}$ above the bottom and the ramp is $3.0\ \text{m}$ long. The block reaches the bottom with a speed of $4.0\ \text{m s}^{-1}$.

**(a)** Calculate the gravitational potential energy lost by the block. **[1]**

**(b)** Calculate the kinetic energy of the block at the bottom. **[1]**

**(c)** Determine the average frictional force on the block. **[2]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $mgh = 2.0 \times 9.8 \times 1.5 = 29\ \text{J}$ ✓

**(b)** $\tfrac{1}{2}mv^2 = \tfrac{1}{2} \times 2.0 \times 4.0^2 = 16\ \text{J}$ ✓

**(c)** Work done against friction $= 29 - 16 = 13\ \text{J}$ ✓; $f = \tfrac{13}{3.0} \approx 4.5\ \text{N}$ ✓ (allow ECF from (a) and (b))
